topic: Workload migration comparison: on-premises to cloud

audience.role: IT leads deciding where a workload should run

outcome: Agree to measure one workload and pilot it before any migration decision.
ideas: One IT admin acts out the story as a silent stickman
Fixed capacity is sized for peaks, so average use is low (illustrative 18%)
Cloud capacity can follow demand but has its own costs
Measure, validate, compare total cost, then pilot

outline.instruction: Open with the decision the audience faces
Show why fixed capacity sits idle
Show elastic capacity and its honest trade-offs
Show how to build the evidence as a flow

sources.title: Illustrative utilisation example (not a measurement)
sources.note: The 18% average-use figure is an illustrative example for the story, not measured data.
